# Purdue University

> > Purdue University is a public research university with campuses in West Lafayette, Hammond, and Westville, offering comprehensive academic programs, employee resources, and student services for the Boilermaker community.

Purdue serves students, faculty, and staff across multiple campuses including Purdue University Global. The university provides extensive support services through centers like the Center for Healthy Living (CHL), Native American Educational and Cultural Center (NAECC), and various employee development programs utilizing platforms like LinkedIn Learning and SuccessFactors.

## Academic Programs & Admissions

- [Office of the Vice Provost for Graduate Students and Postdoctoral Scholars](https://www.purdue.edu/academics/ogsps/prospective/index.php): OGSPS graduate programs & admissions for West Lafayette & Indianapolis campuses
- [How to Apply - Purdue Online](https://www.purdue.edu/online/how-to-apply): Step-by-step guide for applying to Purdue Online graduate programs

## Employee Resources & Human Resources

- [Working @ Purdue - Human Resources](https://www.purdue.edu/hr/workpurdue/index.php): Employee resources hub covering HR services, development & wellness programs
- [Employee Development - Human Resources](https://www.purdue.edu/hr/workpurdue/empdev.php): Employee training via SuccessFactors Learning & LinkedIn Learning platforms
- [Telehealth - Center for Healthy Living](https://www.purdue.edu/hr/CHL/Services/telehealth.php): CHL telehealth services with 24/7 virtual care via TextCare app for employees
- [Meet the Providers - Center for Healthy Living](https://www.purdue.edu/hr/CHL/Staff/index.php): CHL healthcare providers including primary care & behavioral health staff

## Student Services & Cultural Centers

- [Native American Educational and Cultural Center](https://www.purdue.edu/naecc): NAECC provides cultural & educational resources for Native American students
- [Mindfulness - RecWell](https://www.purdue.edu/recwell/fitness-wellness/wellness/mindfulness.php): RecWell mindfulness resources including CoRec Mindfulness Room & meditation

## Campus Security & Compliance

- [Security Awareness and Resources - Secure Purdue](https://www.purdue.edu/securepurdue/forms-and-resources/index.php): Security awareness resources including CERIAS & LinkedIn Learning training
- [Purdue Hotline](https://www.purdue.edu/hotline/index.php): EthicsPoint hotline for anonymous reporting of fraud & misconduct concerns
- [Student Internships - Police Department](https://www.purdue.edu/ehps/police/about/internships.php): Police Department internship opportunities for Criminal Justice students

## Financial Services & Forms

- [Bursar Forms - Finance](https://www.purdue.edu/treasurer/finance/bursar-office/bursar-forms): Office of the Bursar forms for student accounts, tuition & fee remission

## University Information & History

- [Past Purdue University Presidents](https://www.purdue.edu/home/about/history/presidents): Historical timeline of Purdue presidents from 1872 to present

## Optional

- [Awards - Office of Engagement](https://www.purdue.edu/engagement/our-story/awards): Office of Engagement faculty & partner awards for community engagement
- [Sustainability - University Surplus](https://www.purdue.edu/surplus/about/sustainability.html): Surplus Store sustainability efforts in recycling, reuse & asset redistribution
- [PUIOA - Intramural Sports](https://www.purdue.edu/recwell/sports-and-programs/intramural/puioa.php): Purdue Intramural Officials Association with IHSAA certification & training
